import { ShieldAlert, Globe2, Activity } from 'lucide-react'; interface FindingsSummaryProps { nucleiFindings: { info: number; low: number; medium: number; high: number; critical: number }; wapitiVulns: number; wapitiPages: number; } export default function FindingsSummary({ nucleiFindings, wapitiVulns, wapitiPages }: FindingsSummaryProps) { const totalFindings = nucleiFindings.critical + nucleiFindings.high + nucleiFindings.medium + nucleiFindings.low + nucleiFindings.info + wapitiVulns; return (
{/* Total Overview */}
Total Findings
{totalFindings}
{/* Severity Breakdown Badges */}
Critical: {nucleiFindings.critical}
High: {nucleiFindings.high}
Med: {nucleiFindings.medium}
Low: {nucleiFindings.low}
Info: {nucleiFindings.info}
{/* Wapiti DAST Summary */}
DAST: {wapitiVulns} vulns ({wapitiPages} crawled)
); }
